function.name: calculate_Bond_Price
function.description: Calculate the bond price given the face value, coupon rate, required rate of return, and maturity period. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.content:
抱歉，我目前無法即時查詢最新的市場數據。若您需要今天美國黃金的即時價格，建議您參考以下幾個常用來源：

| 來源 | 連結 | 特色 |
|------|------|------|
| **Kitco** | https://www.kitco.com/ | 提供全球黃金、白銀等貴金屬即時價格與歷史走勢圖。 |
| **Bloomberg** | https://www.bloomberg.com/markets | 金融新聞平台，提供黃金期貨、現貨價格及相關分析。 |
| **Investing.com** | https://www.investing.com/commodities/gold | 具備即時行情、圖表與技術分析工具。 |
| **Yahoo Finance** | https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/GC=F/ | 以期貨價格為主，亦可查看現貨報價。 |

如果您想要更精確的數字（例如美元/盎司），可以直接在上述網站上搜尋「Gold」或「Gold Futures (GC)」即可看到最新報價。若您有其他關於黃金投資、歷史走勢或市場分析的問題，也歡迎隨時告訴我！
message.reasoning: User asks: "今天美國的黃金價格是多少？" They want today's gold price in US. We need to provide current price. We don't have real-time data. We can approximate or say we don't have real-time data. We can provide typical gold price or explain. We can also ask for clarification. Probably best to say we don't have real-time data.
